{
  "conversations": [
    {
      "title": "Rent a surfboard",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I'd like to rent a surfboard." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "What kind of board do you need?" },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "A funboard, please." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "A longboard, please.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "How long will you rent it?" },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "For three days." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Just for today.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "How much is it?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "It's twenty dollars a day." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I'll take it, thanks." }
      ],
      "vocab": ["rent", "surfboard", "funboard", "longboard", "day", "price"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Ask about wave conditions",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "What's the surf like today?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "The waves are small and clean." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "The waves are big and choppy.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Are there strong currents?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "No, the current is weak." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Yes, the current is strong.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "When's the best time to surf?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Early morning." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Thanks, I'll go then." }
      ],
      "vocab": ["wave", "current", "strong", "clean", "surf", "early"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Get local food recommendations",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Where can I get good local food?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Try the soda near the plaza." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Try the fish market.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "What do you recommend?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Try the casado." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Try the ceviche.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Is it spicy?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "No, it's mild." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Yes, it's spicy.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I'll try the casado, thanks." }
      ],
      "vocab": ["recommend", "soda", "plaza", "casado", "ceviche", "spicy"]
    }
  ]
}
